messages:
maria: FYI eu-west-2 GPU warm-pool failing to join since 06:12. Keystore decrypt timeouts after last-night default-deny FW roll.

sam: kubelet logs show `KMSGrantAccessDenied` and `tcp reset` to keystore 10.2.5.21:443.

jin: confirmed fw-roll fw-2026-03-22 removed controlplane egress allow. It's blocking keystore CIDR.

adrian: security clipped the rule for PCI scope. No wide subnet openings. We need a scoped exception + full audit.

maria: short-term options: SG allow to 10.2.5.21/32 OR NAT proxy. Privatelink not provisioned here.

leila: cost note: warm-pool sync ~1.8TB/day. NAT egress ~ $0.09/GB => ~ $160/day if proxied. OPEX hit.

security-bot: policy: no broad egress. Exceptions require ticket + approver + rollback.

sam: proposed plan: (1) SG exception for keystore IP /32; (2) 5-node canary; (3) backfill from us-west if failure; (4) enable keystore retry.

jin: canary first. backfill hurts latency/KV cache. Ops: monitor 30m.

adrian: approve 24h scoped SG exception with packet capture & audit sampling. Rollback scheduled.

maria: opening ticket and runbook, will capture tcpdump + keystore logs, triggering canary now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary queued id cb-20260322-77.

maria: canary joined after ~12m; decrypt errors cleared. Keeping exception until config patch shipped.

sam: next: prefer privatelink in eu-west-2 or deploy read-only local keystore replica. Cost/ops analysis due EOD.

leila: finance: worst-case NAT re-route estimated ~$4k/week. Need emergency spend OK.

security-bot: exception logged INC-1248; reviewers assigned. Upload tcpdump+logs to ticket.

maria: will follow up with perf regressions and remediation plan. Thanks.
